name: GhostDialog
description: Themed wrappers around headless GhostDialog, GhostDialogTrigger, GhostDialogOverlay, GhostDialogContent, GhostDialogTitle, GhostDialogDescription, and GhostDialogClose. Importing from @ghostvue/themes loads the default elevation-4 dialog and scrim stylesheet.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state forwarded to headless GhostDialog.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when open is omitted.

props.name: modal
props.description: Enables modal behavior (trapped focus, scroll lock, inert background, overlay).

slots.name: default
slots.description: Dialog trigger, overlay, content, title, description, and close parts.

parts.name: overlay
parts.description: Full-viewport backdrop rendered by GhostDialogOverlay with data-themed.

parts.name: content
parts.description: Centered elevation-4 dialog surface rendered by GhostDialogContent with data-themed.

parts.name: description
parts.description: Muted supporting description rendered by GhostDialogDescription.

states.name: open
states.description: Applied to trigger, overlay, and content while open.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-scrim
cssProperties.description: Backdrop color of GhostDialogOverlay (falls back to rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5) when undefined).

cssProperties.name: --ghost-text-muted
cssProperties.description: Muted text color applied to GhostDialogDescription.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-space-inset-lg
cssProperties.description: Internal padding and viewport margin of GhostDialogContent.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-space-gap-md
cssProperties.description: Vertical spacing between sections inside GhostDialogContent.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-focus-ring-color
cssProperties.description: Outer focus-visible outline color when content receives focus.

keyboard.Enter: Opens or toggles the dialog when focused on the trigger, or closes when focused on GhostDialogClose.
keyboard.Space: Opens or toggles the dialog when focused on the trigger, or closes when focused on GhostDialogClose.
keyboard.Escape: Dismisses the topmost open dialog when closeOnEscape is true and restores focus.
